sourceCaveats: Complete official November3,2026 county question supplied by the designated election official’s current pro/con notice, citing BoardResolution26-34. No further ballot-qualification condition is stated.
Official title is recorded; number is unrecorded because the notice leaves it blank. A missing number alone does not prevent publication under§3.
County clerk page exposes no current general sample; separate school, city or district notices remain to be inventoried. No claim of countywide local completeness is made.
limits: One source-backed county question, not a complete denominator for all local questions in HuerfanoCounty or Colorado.
